immutable_ref_rules.mathlib_and_manifest_packages: existing lake-manifest commit and package tree; working trees must remain unmodified
immutable_ref_rules.external: branch or index discoveries receive no candidate credit until resolved to a 40-hex commit and inspected there
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: dated SHA-256-bound discovery observations only; not immutable source or proof evidence

credentials_policy: Use unauthenticated public endpoints only. Record denial or rate limiting as an access failure, never as a negative result.
expected_negative_evidence: Record the bounded query, completion state, match count, response SHA-256 where observed, and access limitation. Zero results never imply internet-wide absence.
classification_policy: Normalize every declaration against the exact frozen target. General transfer and focal theorems lacking the existential conjugacy-into-M conclusion are M3 substrate or M5 non-substitutes. M1 requires immutable independently reproducible kernel evidence. M0 requires a repo-local checked exact wrapper and accepted trust closure.
credit_boundary: This protocol governs the bounded anchor inventory only. It supplies no proof, H0, M0, AUDIT-Z, or theorem-completion credit.
